module_summary: Serial two's complementer: a 3-state Moore FSM consumes x LSB-first and outputs the complemented bit stream on z.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Remembers whether the first 1 bit was seen and current output bit.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Serial two's-complement output bit, decoded from state C.

groups.name: complementer_fsm
groups.description: Passes bits until first 1, then inverts; z decoded from state.
